The BGM maintains a consistent volume and rhythm underneath the speech. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide relationship advice and insights into male dating psychology, specifically analyzing the behaviors of men who are only interested in casual physical encounters. The video uses a 'simmering' metaphor to explain why some men disappear and then return later, aiming to educate and warn female viewers.
